title: Clan Battery
wikitext: Battery was originally a HPW clan founded by dakoth, multi, judge, xone and raiden. Eventually the clan sort of broke off as half the members remained HPW and the other half gained LPB status. The clan has since been in "limbo", with only a handful of games ever played as LPB's. More recently, the flag has been picked up by [[dakoth]] and [[ermac]], using the tag in their 2on2 tournaments and games.
